title: Illnesses You May Inherit From Your Mother
summary: Your mother's side of the family can hold surprising health clues. Some conditions follow maternal inheritance, while many others simply run in families through a mix of genes, biology, and shared environment. This guide breaks down the conditions people most often ask about, without treating family history as destiny.
disclaimer: This article is general information only and is not medical advice. Family history does not confirm that you have or will develop any condition.

items.title: Mitochondrial Disease
paragraphs: Mitochondrial conditions are the clearest example of maternal inheritance because mitochondria come from the egg cell. Symptoms vary widely, so a strong family pattern is a reason to ask about genetic counseling rather than guessing from symptoms alone.

Family history is a clue, not a verdict. If this condition appears repeatedly among close relatives, bring that pattern to a qualified healthcare professional or genetic counselor before changing treatment, screening, or medication.
